With this investment, Levanta has now raised more than $43 million in total funding. The new capital will support continued investment in Levanta’s creator commerce technology and go-to-market organization while accelerating its expansion across the retail ecosystem, including bringing dozens of additional retail marketplaces onto the platform and advancing the company’s vision for Creator Commerce Media.
